creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/FM/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_aftermath/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python) and Node 24 (v24.12.0 used). render.py runs studio/audio/cli.mjs on score.json; the output parent directory must exist.
patch: Studio audio score, MT19937 seed 6301 (per note [seed, event, layer]). Voices: soft bell (FM sine, ratio 2, index 0.35, plus a faint 2.003x partial, 1.7 s decay) stating three falling phrases D4-A4; breath (low-passed noise sweeping 700 to 260 Hz with 0.4 Hz swell) answering in the empty bars; triangle drone D2+A2, then B2+F#3 from bar 9. Seeded-noise impulse reverb 3.0 s, wet 0.42, folded across the loop boundary.
tuning: D major pentatonic (D E F# A B), tonal center D; A4 = 440 Hz
register_note: The 1.6-5 kHz band that carries the enemy tells holds -40 dB of total energy. Measured mono energy share (engine bands): 0-100 Hz -10.64 dB, 100-450 Hz -0.51 dB, 450-1600 Hz -16.23 dB, 1600-5000 Hz -40 dB, 5000-22050 Hz -63.15 dB.
structure: 16 bars at 48 BPM. Bell phrases enter at bars 1, 5, 9 (an octave lower) and 13 (two bars each); the breath exhales in bars 3, 7, 11 and 15; bars 3-4, 7-8, 11-12 and 15-16 hold no bell, so the bed is mostly rests. The drone moves from D2+A2 to B2+F#3 at bar 9 and the loop wraps back to D.
proposal: Tempo, length, loop point and structure are the author's proposal (docs/AUDIO_DESIGN.md, 'Modes proposal'); the project owner settled only the one-sentence brief of the mode and the order to go ahead.
loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: Notes, drone and reverb tails wrap modulo the loop; frame 0 continues from frame loopEnd - 1.

verification.rebuild: Rendered by the Studio audio engine; render twice gives byte-identical WAV (tools/tests/test_audio_modes.py rebuilds into a scratch directory and compares).
verification.meter: Studio audio engine measure (BS.1770 K-weighted LUFS, 4x oversampled true-peak estimate); pack evidence re-measures with the pinned FFmpeg 6.1.1 ebur128.
verification.scale_check: Every pitched note is inside the declared pentatonic (key.enforce true; the engine raises out_of_scale otherwise).
